snippet.title: इकरार हो न जाए | Zinda Dil | Udit Narayan Songs | Abbas | Ashima Bhalla
snippet.description:
2000 के दशक की जादुई आवाज़ और दिल को छू लेने वाले संगीत की बात हो, तो उदित नारायण का नाम सबसे पहले आता है। 'ज़िंदा दिल' फिल्म का यह खूबसूरत नगमा 'इकरार हो न जाए' प्यार की उन कोमल भावनाओं को बयां करता है जो हर दिल की धड़कन में बसती हैं। यह गाना उस सुनहरे दौर की याद दिलाता है जब संगीत सिर्फ धुन नहीं, बल्कि एक एहसास हुआ करता था।



Credits :

Song: Ikrar Ho Na Jaye
Album: Zinda Dil
Artist: Udit Narayan
Music Director: Nadeem-Shravan
Lyricist: Sameer 



Lyrics :

O ho ho ey hey hey
Iqaraar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
O ho ho hey hey hey hey
Hey hey hey.. Hey hey hey hey


Saagar ki maujein hain
Khulaa aasmaan hai
Dhadkan deevaani hai
Dilkash samaa hai
Dhadkan deevaani hai
Dilkash samaa hai
Khvaabon ke hamsafar
Kaa deedaar ho na jaaye
Khvaabon ke hamsafar
Kaa deedaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
O ho ho ho ho ho
Hey hey hey.. Hey hey hey hey


Jee chaahe lahron se
Karoon main sharaarat
Inko bataa doon main
Mere dil ki chaahat
Inko bataa doon main
Mere dil ki chaahat
Koi deevaanaa meraa
Dildaar ho na jaaye
Koi deevaanaa meraa
Dildaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
O ho ho hey hey hey hey
O ho ho hey hey hey hey
Iqaraar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
Hey hey hey.. Ey hey hey
O ho ho ey hey hey.

इस मधुर गीत को सुनें और प्यार के उस एहसास में खो जाएं। अगर आपको यह गाना पसंद आया, तो वीडियो को लाइक करें, कमेंट में अपने पसंदीदा रोमांटिक गानों के बारे में बताएं और हमारे चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करना न भूलें ताकि आप संगीत की इस यात्रा में हमारे साथ बने रहें। Let the magic of music live on…

snippet.description:
Kismat Sath Nhi Deti – Aarzoo Khaan | Emotional Hindi Sad Song | New Song 2026 | Arijit Singh Vibe


---

Kismat sath nhi deti...
warna mohabbat adhuri na rehti.

Humne to dil se chaha tha...
har dua me tumhe hi maanga tha...
magar taqdeer ko
hamara milna manzoor na tha.

Kabhi kabhi
mohabbat kam nahi hoti...
sirf kismat saath nahi deti.

“Kismat Sath Nhi Deti”
ek aise dil ki kahani hai
jo sachche pyaar ke baad bhi
apni manzil tak na pahunch saka.

Aaj bhi dil me
tera hi naam hai...
aur har dua me
teri khushi maangte hain.

Is gaane mein
mohabbat bhi hai,
judai bhi hai,
aur ek gehra ehsaas bhi
jo dheere se kehta hai —

kash kismat bhi...
hamara saath deti...

Agar aapne bhi
kabhi kisi ko
apni rooh se zyada chaha ho
aur sirf kismat ki wajah se usse kho diya ho,
to ye gaana
aapke dil ko chhoo jaayega.

snippet.title: [EN] 2026 PMMI Grand Finals Day 3
snippet.description:
🔴  2026 PUBG MOBILE MACAO INVITATIONAL 🔴

🔥One vs All !

🔈2026 PMMI will unfold in two stages across six heated competition days.
🌍 This tournament will feature 25 top-tier teams from multiple regions worldwide.

🗓 Group Stage Days
● June 29 (Mon) - 17:20 (GMT+8:00)
● June 30 (Tue) - 17:20 (GMT+8:00)
● July 1 (Wed) - 17:20 (GMT+8:00)

Finals
● July 3 (Fri) - 15:40 (GMT+8:00)
● July 4 (Sat) - 15:40 (GMT+8:00)
● July 5 (Sun) - 16:00 (GMT+8:00)

🎖️Participating teams
GOAT  #2026 PMGO S1 EECA #2
A7 #2025 PMGC #1
AURORA  #2026 PMGO S1 EECA #1
BTR #2025 PMHI #3
DK #2026 PMPS S1 #5
EA  #2026 PMGO S1 SEA #2
FURIA  #2026 PMGO S1 SAM #1
INF # 2026 PMGO S1 SAM #5
KONE  # 2026 PEL Spring #7
KRX #2026 PMPS S1 #4
KSG  # 2026 PEL Spring #5
LGD  # 2026 PEL Spring #3
NGX  #2026 PMGO S1 MENA #2
NS #2026 PMPS S1 #1  
REG # 2025 PMGO #1
RRQ  #2026 PMGO S1 SEA #3 
S2G #2026 PMGO S1 TUR #4
TIANBA  # 2026 PEL Spring #6
TT  # 2026 PEL Spring #2
ULA  #2026 PMGO S1 MENA #1
ULF # 2026 PMGO S1 TUR #1
WBG  # 2025 PMHI #1
WOL  # 2026 PMGO S1 NA  #1  
YG #2025 PMWC #1
AG # 2026 PEL Spring #1

💸 Total prize pool：$440,000 USD

🔔Format
●  24 teams divided into three groups. Each group plays six matches against each other, and the 15 teams with the highest total points advance to the finals.
●  PEL Spring Split champion AG qualifies directly for the final stage. 16 teams will compete in a total of 18  matches over three days to contend for the final championship.

🔔Smash rule
● Reach match point and secure a WWCD in the next matches to become the champion.
● Match point: rank#1 in points + 10 points at the end of the match 12/18 (Day2)
● If no wins by smash after 18 matches, the team ranked #1 by overall points wins!"

snippet.title: Panther - Dooriyan ft. @Akankshachoudhary_official (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Some distances are measured in miles. The hardest ones are measured in memories.

Dooriyan is a story of love that refuses to fade, even when life pulls two people apart. It's about unanswered prayers, unspoken words, and the hope that some hearts never truly let go of each other.

If you've ever missed someone who still lives in your thoughts, this one's for you.

Stream Dooriyan on all audio platforms.
Let us know in the comments: Who does this song remind you of? 💬

Subscribe here - https://www.youtube.com/c/buildingpanther

Lyrics

na jane kaise faasley
na jane kaise hai giley
na jaane kaise rastey
na jane kaisi manzilein hai
na jane kitne hadsey
humpe aake hai girey
na jane kiske wastey hai sahey
lekin na rakhte hai giley

tumse ye dooriyan mita dengi
humko ye dooriyaan hi marengi
bin tere jeena mushqil ho gaya hai janejaan
ye dooriyan kya jaan leke manengi

bana ke rakhna tumse fasla
lage jaise bin mitti ka paudha
mai har bazi tumpe hi haru
khatir tere kar lu mai ghatey ka sauda
mai pyaasa aur pani hai tu
raha zamana jala, 
de chune bhar ka mauka
qubool hai tere pehlu sarey 
tu jaise khuda ka hai tohfa

khuda se mai dua padhu teri
mangu ram se puja me tujhe
ye duniya tere bin hai khokhli
har jagah tbhi dhundha hai tumhe
humko chahat na badan ki tere
bas tera hai choona man mujhe 
tu sachai hai iss wajood ki
baki toh lagta hai jhutha sab mujhe

umeedein mujhko tere wapis aane ki
barbadi na hui to kya hi ashiqui
to bata fir kyu iss tarah hum chahey nahi
aur tum bhi khoob 
jo ab tak aaye nahi

tumse ye dooriyan mita dengi
humko ye dooriyaan hi marengi
bin tere jeena mushqil ho gaya hai janejaan
ye dooriyan kya jaan leke manengi


Credits

Engineered by Sidhant Choudhury

snippet.title: Dil Pe Zakham (Music Video) Madhur Sharma | Ustad Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan | Jaan Se Guzarte Hai
snippet.description:
Experience the pain, passion, and timeless soul of "Dil Pe Zakham", beautifully rendered by Madhur Sharma. Inspired by the immortal poetry and legacy of the legendary Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan, this heartfelt rendition blends soulful vocals with contemporary production to create an unforgettable musical experience.

If you've ever loved deeply, lost someone special, or found solace in music, this song will speak directly to your heart.

Singer- Madhur Sharma
Music- Moin

snippet.title: Hathma Kartalu Mira Dwarikama Jay - DHUN - Kiran Prajapati - હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા - Gujrati Bhajan
snippet.description:
Kiran Prajapati Presents...

Hathma Kartalu Mira Dwarikama Jay - DHUN - Kiran Prajapati - હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય - Gujrati Bhajan

Title : Hathma Kartalu Mira Dwarikama Jay - DHUN - Kiran Prajapati - હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય - Gujrati Bhajan

Singer: Kiran Prajapati 
Music: Manoj Vimal 
Mixing: Hardik Sagar
Dhun Mandli: Botad  
Video: Maruti Movies (Shailesh Patel)
Editing: Studio Lights View
Disign:  Kaushal Prajapati
Light : Nilkanth Light Botad
Lable: Kiran Prajapati

LYRICS:
હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય છે 
ઘોડાલીયે અસવારી રાણો પાછળ પાછળ જાય છે 
મારુ કેવું માનો મીરા પાછા વળી જાવ ને 
હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય છે

ભગવો રે ભેખ મીરા તમને નથી શોભતો 
તમને શોભે છે હીર અને ચીર રે 
મારુ કેવું માનો મીરા પાછા વળી જાવ ને 
હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય છે

ચંદન કેરા તિલક મીરા તમને નથી શોભતા 
તમને શોભે છે કંકુના તિલક રે 
મારુ કેવું માનો મીરા પાછા વળી જાવ ને 
હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય છે

હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા તમને નથી શોભતી 
તમને શોભે છે સોના ના ચૂડલા 
મારુ કેવું માનો મીરા પાછા વળી જાવ ને 
હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય છે

પગે બાંધ્યા ઘૂઘરા મીરા તમને નથી શોભતા 
તમને શોભે છે કામ્બિ ને કંડલા રે 
મારુ કેવું માનો મીરા પાછા વળી જાવ ને 
હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય છે

દ્વારિકાના મંદિર મીરા તમને નથી શોભતા 
તમને શોભે છે રાણા નો દરબાર 
મારુ કેવું માનો મીરા પાછા વળી જાવ ને 
હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય છે

કનૈયાના નામ મીરા તમને નથી શોભતા 
તમે મીરા લ્યોને આ રાણાજીના નામ રે 
મારુ કેવું માનો મીરા પાછા વળી જાવ ને 
હાથમાં કરતાલુ મીરા દ્વારિકામાં જાય છે

te.title: జూలై 5, 2026 | ఫ్రాన్స్ v పరాగ్వే | రౌండ్ ఆఫ్ 16 | ఫిఫా వరల్డ్ కప్ 26 | ఫుట్‌బాల్ | FC26 గేమ్‌ప్లే
te.description:
✅ నమస్కారం,

ఫిఫా ప్రపంచ కప్ 2026 యొక్క ఈ ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన రౌండ్ ఆఫ్ 16 పోరులో ఫ్రాన్స్, పరాగ్వే తలపడుతుండగా, హై డెఫినిషన్ ఫిఫా ప్రపంచ కప్ 26 నాకౌట్ ఫుట్‌బాల్ యొక్క ఉత్సాహాన్ని అనుభవించండి! క్వార్టర్ ఫైనల్స్‌లో స్థానం కోసం జరిగే ఈ తీవ్రమైన EA స్పోర్ట్స్ FC26 గేమ్‌ప్లే సిమ్యులేషన్‌లో, రెండు జట్లు తమ సర్వశక్తులను ఒడ్డి పోరాడతాయి. ఫ్రాన్స్ ప్రపంచ స్థాయి ప్రతిభ, వేగవంతమైన దాడి మరియు బలమైన ఫినిషింగ్‌తో బరిలోకి దిగుతుండగా, పరాగ్వే పట్టుదల, వ్యూహాత్మక క్రమశిక్షణ మరియు ఎదురుదాడి అవకాశాలతో సవాలు విసరాలని చూస్తుంది.

✅ క్వార్టర్ ఫైనల్స్‌లో ఎవరు తమ స్థానాన్ని ఖాయం చేసుకుంటారు? తెలుసుకోవడానికి పూర్తి మ్యాచ్ చూడండి! 🔔 మరిన్ని ఫిఫా ప్రపంచ కప్ 2026 గేమ్‌ప్లే వీడియోల కోసం లైక్, కామెంట్ & సబ్‌స్క్రైబ్ చేయండి! అందరికీ ధన్యవాదాలు.

pa.title: 5 ਜੁਲਾਈ, 2026 | ਫਰਾਂਸ ਬਨਾਮ ਪੈਰਾਗੁਏ | ਰਾਊਂਡ ਆਫ਼ 16 | ਫੀਫਾ ਵਰਲਡ ਕੱਪ 26 | ਫੁੱਟਬਾਲ | FC26 ਗੇਮਪਲੇ
pa.description:
✅ ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ,
ਫੀਫਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ 2026 ਦੇ ਇਸ ਰੋਮਾਂਚਕ ਦੌਰ ਦੇ 16 ਮੁਕਾਬਲੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਫਰਾਂਸ ਅਤੇ ਪੈਰਾਗੁਏ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਹਾਈ ਡੈਫੀਨੇਸ਼ਨ ਫੀਫਾ WC26 ਨਾਕਆਊਟ ਫੁੱਟਬਾਲ ਦੇ ਉਤਸ਼ਾਹ ਦਾ ਅਨੁਭਵ ਕਰੋ! ਕੁਆਰਟਰ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਗ੍ਹਾ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ, ਦੋਵੇਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੀਬਰ EA ਸਪੋਰਟਸ FC26 ਗੇਮਪਲੇ ਸਿਮੂਲੇਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਦਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਫਰਾਂਸ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਪੱਧਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਭਾ, ਤੇਜ਼ ਹਮਲਾਵਰ ਖੇਡ ਅਤੇ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ ​​ਫਿਨਿਸ਼ਿੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਕਦਮ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਦੋਂ ਕਿ ਪੈਰਾਗੁਏ ਲਚਕੀਲੇਪਣ, ਰਣਨੀਤਕ ਅਨੁਸ਼ਾਸਨ ਅਤੇ ਜਵਾਬੀ ਹਮਲੇ ਦੇ ਮੌਕਿਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਚੁਣੌਤੀ ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।

✅ ਕੁਆਰਟਰ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੌਣ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਗ੍ਹਾ ਬੁੱਕ ਕਰੇਗਾ? ਇਹ ਜਾਣਨ ਲਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੈਚ ਦੇਖੋ! 🔔 ਹੋਰ ਫੀਫਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ 2026 ਗੇਮਪਲੇ ਵੀਡੀਓਜ਼ ਲਈ ਲਾਈਕ, ਟਿੱਪਣੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਾਈਬ ਕਰੋ! ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਧੰਨਵਾਦ।

snippet.description:
A divine composition that speaks devotion in every note…
Feel the magic of Namo Namo 🕉️

RSVP & Guy In The Sky Pictures present Kedarnath Starring: Sushant Singh Rajput, Sara Ali Khan, Nitish Bharadwaj, Alka Amin, Sonali Sachdev, Pooja Gor, Nishant Dahiya

Produced by Ronnie Screwvala & Pragya Kapoor

Screenplay & Dialogue: Kanika Dhillon

DOP: Tushar Kanti Ray 
Action Director: Dave Judge & Sunil Rodrigues 
Editor: Chandan Arora 
Background Score: Hitesh Sonik 
Sound Designer: Allwin Rego & Sanjay Maurya.

Song: Namo Namo
Singer: Amit Trivedi
Lyricist: Amitabh Bhattacharya

Crew:
Composed & Produced by Amit Trivedi
Recording Engineers A T Studios  Mumbai  - Abhishek Sortey & Urmila Sutar  
Assisted by  Firoz Shaikh
Mixed & Mastered by Shadab Rayeen,  A T Studios & New Edge - Mumbai

Executive Producer A T Studios - Krutee Trivedi
Head Of Production A T Studios - Aashish Narula

Flute - Vishnu Vijay
Sitar - Kishor

(Bholenath Shankara)
Aadi Dev Shankara
(Hey Shivay Shankara)

(Bholenath Shankara)
Chale Ye Saans Kis Tarah
(Hey Shivay Shankara)

Kya Bura Hai Kya Bhalaa…
Tere Raaste Pe Main Toh
Aankh Moond Ke Chalaa…

Tere Naam Ki Jot Ne
Saara Har Liya Tamas Mera

Namo Namo Ji Shankara
Bholenath Shankara
Hey Triloknath Shambhu
Hey Shivay Shankara

Namo Namo Ji Shankara
Bholenath Shankara
Rudradev Hey Maheshvarah

Srishti Ke Janam Se Bhi
(O O…)
Pehle Tera Vaas Tha
(O O…)
Ye Jag Rahe Ya Naa Rahe
(O O…)
Rahegi Teri Aastha
(O O…)

Kya Samay… Kya Pralay
Dono Mein Teri Mahaanta
Mahaanta… Mahaanta…

Seepiyon Ki Ontt Main
(Bholenath Shankara)
Motiyaan Ho Jis Tarah
(Hey Shivay Shankara)
Mere Mann Mein Shankara
(Bholenath Shankara)
Tu Basa Hai Uss Tarah
(Hey Shivay Shankara)

Mujhe Bharam Tha Jo Hai Mera
Tha Nahin Kabhi Mera…

Arth Kya Nirarth Kya
Jo Bhi Hai Sabhi Tera…
Tere Saamne Hai Jhuka
Mere Sar Pe Haath Rakh Tera

Bholenath Shankara
Hey Triloknath Shambhu
Hey Shivay Shankara

Namo Namo Ji Shankara
Bholenath Shankara
Rudradev Hey Maheshvara

Chandrama Lalaat Pe (O O…)
Bhasm Hai Bhujaaon Mein (O O…)
Vastra Baagh Chhaal Ka (O O…)
Hai Khadau Paanv Mein (O O…)

Pyaas Kya Ho Tujhe
Ganga Hai Teri Jataaon Mein
Jataaon Mein… Jataaon Mein…

Doosron Ke Waaste
(Bholenath Shankara)
Tu Sadaiv Hai Jiya

snippet.title: 😭 Franklin Became Homeless Because of Shinchan! 😱 GTA 5 Malayalam
snippet.description:
😱 Shinchan wants to marry Dora, but everything goes horribly wrong! After being tricked by Dora's Grandma, Franklin unknowingly loses his mansion, cars, and everything he owns. Forced to leave the city with his family, Franklin starts a new life in the countryside as a farmer.

One mysterious night, Franklin discovers a hidden Golden Burger buried underground that changes his life forever. But while Franklin is rebuilding his life, Shinchan is trapped and treated like a assistant by Dora's Grandma. Can Franklin save Shinchan, expose the truth, and get his mansion back?

❤️ Watch till the end for an emotional, funny, and action-packed GTA 5 Malayalam adventure with Franklin, Shinchan, Dora, Shiranui, Pinchan, Chop, and more!

📝 YouTube Description

🎶 Elangaathu Veesudhey is a timeless Tamil romantic melody from the acclaimed movie Pithamagan.

🎤 Sung beautifully by Sriram Parthasarathy and Shreya Ghoshal, the song is loved for its soulful vocals, emotional depth, and soothing musical charm.

🎼 Music composed by Isaignani Ilaiyaraaja gives the track a mesmerizing melody that continues to captivate generations of Tamil music lovers.

✍️ Lyrics written by Pazhani Bharathi beautifully express love, longing, and heartfelt emotions through poetic verses.

🎬 Featured in the critically acclaimed film Pithamagan, this evergreen melody remains one of the most cherished romantic songs in Tamil cinema.

✨ A timeless Tamil classic filled with melody, emotion, and Ilaiyaraaja's unforgettable musical brilliance.
